text: Reception reported 93 of 183 rooms occupied on Monday 23 Nov (50.8%), 43 of them Rabdan, up from 91 on 21 Nov. There were no check-ins or check-outs; Reception logged 4 new inquiries, 3 property viewings and 1 booking confirmation, and 6 guest complaints, all resolved.
All tracked departments reported for 23 Nov — Operations, Reception, Maintenance, IT, HR & Accounts, the Flower shop and AJ1881 — except Housekeeping, which was not seen.

Maintenance logged 14 completed jobs (several rows repeat), including the FCU leak near room 609, room 611 pipes, B4 drainage cleaning and the B4 inventory room door closer. Still pending: the room 706 thermostat, basement parking lights, the rooftop calorifier and gas boiler leaks, and the 12th-floor wooden accessories check.

The CEO asked the Operations Manager to own the internal maintenance plan and send an action plan with responsibilities, staffing and target dates. Operations replied that the in-house team will take over pest control, drainage, pool and AC duct cleaning; the action plan is not yet seen.

Operations sent three elevator AMC quotations (Ever Gravity, Circle Elevators, Clipston Lifts) for urgent approval, calling the lifts a high safety risk. AJ1881 again asked for approval to buy bar and kitchen supplies and to rename the shop Oui Cafe. Room 710 FCU rewinding, the lobby partition, the MBG proposal, the Pilates studio, driver selection and offer letters and visa processing are still awaiting decision.

AJ1881 sold AED 52 from 2 covers (beverages only) on a slow Monday. The flower shop recorded no sales and made a UAE National Day arrangement for social media. Operations contacted 7 contracting companies about staff accommodation; Al Nasr Contracting asked for a proposal by email.

IT fixed a Wi-Fi issue in room 1506, a TV in room 1603 and the parking gate barrier, and finalised the positions of the 13 new CCTV cameras, which are still to be installed. The Equal software is still slow. A revised Foodics POS quotation was received, and the tower was listed on Dubizzle, Airbnb, Property Finder and Bayut.
